name: Index

x.description: Input tensor, any shape (1D-4D). Supports float32, float16, bfloat16.

dim.description: int, dimension along which to index.

index.description: 1D tensor of int64 indices into dim.

y.description: Tensor with selected elements along dim. Same dtype as x.

description:
Index: Returns a new tensor which indexes the input tensor along dimension dim using the entries in index.

torch.index_select = index_select(input, dim, index, *, out=None) -> Tensor

The returned tensor has the same number of dimensions as the original tensor (input). The dim-th dimension has the same size as the length of index; other dimensions have the same size as in the original tensor.

Note: The returned tensor does NOT use the same storage as the original tensor. If out has a different shape than expected, we silently change it to the correct shape, reallocating the underlying storage if necessary.

Args:
    input (Tensor): the input tensor.
    dim (int): the dimension in which we index.
    index (IntTensor or LongTensor): the 1-D tensor containing the indices to index.

Keyword args:
    out (Tensor, optional): the output tensor.

Example:
    >>> x = torch.randn(3, 4)
    >>> indices = torch.tensor([0, 2])
    >>> torch.index_select(x, 0, indices)
    tensor([[0.1427, 0.0231, -0.5414, -1.0009],
            [-1.1734, -0.6571, 0.7230, -0.6004]])

Returns: Tensor, same dtype as input.
